reasons: A proposed refund above USD 100 needs prior team lead approval. VIP tier does not change the limit.
A refund request does not prove eligibility or a game fault. No money is moved by this plugin.
missing_information: Game/round evidence and any recorded approval; neither is available in the export.
model_notes: Baseline accepted: refund / P2 / Team Lead. Requested refund is 250.00 USD, above the USD 100 agent limit, so it needs recorded team-lead approval BEFORE any refund is issued; the customer's Gold status does not waive the limit and the closed historical reply on T-5010 (withdrawal limits) is unrelated and is not a precedent for refunds. A refund request does not establish eligibility: no game/round ID, no provider or game-log evidence, and no recorded approval exist in the export, and the transaction list shows deposits and a completed withdrawal but no bet record for the disputed round. Support cannot credit anything manually. Reply must acknowledge and explain that the round needs to be checked, without admitting a platform fault we cannot verify and without promising a refund or "today". Do not state or imply money has been moved. Note: customer is verified KYC and not self-excluded. Escalation required for the approval decision. Sources: tickets.json#T-5106, transactions.csv#TX-86102/#TX-86390/#TX-86590, support-handbook-v2.md#refunds, support-handbook-v2.md#escalation.
